truth_rules.current_selector: This file alone selects live operational state.
truth_rules.implementation_facts: Use live repository, PR, CI, filesystem, and tool evidence.
truth_rules.legacy_surfaces: Legacy selectors are compatibility projections or history only and may not override this file.
truth_rules.cross_program_successor_rule: Before successor selection, consult governance/application-planning/ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json. Individual program strict_successor or backlog fields cannot skip an eligible interstitial program or override cross-program gates.
truth_rules.executor_independence: Executor availability never grants or revokes project authority.
truth_rules.parallel_lane_rule: GPR, CWKS and the persistent fashion lane (`fga`, currently FDE) remain independent persistent lanes. Terminal FGA/CASI/MRCS/OARC remain completed history. FIFO READY publication coordination exists while two or more persistent lanes are nonterminal.
truth_rules.protected_main_interlock: Protected main remains PR-only and exact-head. Single-active-lane mode uses one fresh-main drift-sensitive integration receipt with expected-head merge protection and no READY queue. Multi-lane mode uses FIFO READY coordination. Direct main writes remain prohibited.
truth_rules.persistent_execution_lanes: OPS3 preserves exactly three independent persistent implementation lanes: gpr, cwks and fga. The fga lane now hosts owner-approved FDE productization over terminal completed FGA authority. Terminal MSAS, MRCS, OARC, CASI, MVPS, UISR and FGA remain completed program history.
truth_rules.no_progress_loop: Repeated owner execution commands with unchanged material_progress_seq are OPS3.NO_MATERIAL_PROGRESS and require stall diagnosis/recovery before another ordinary execution cycle.
truth_rules.generated_main_writers: CI/bots/generated-content jobs may not push directly to protected main; generated outputs must be present on the queue-bound candidate branch or validation fails closed.
truth_rules.lane_state_isolation: Live execution progress for persistent lanes is recorded on ops3-lane-state/gpr, ops3-lane-state/cwks and ops3-lane-state/fga. Terminal MSAS, MRCS, OARC and CASI lane states are historical only. CURRENT selects work globally; lane-state refs cannot select successors or mutate another lane.
truth_rules.executor_interruption: A chat/tool/session interruption is an executor incident, never a project lock. Resume from the last durable lane-state receipt and fresh repository/PR evidence; do not silently wait or replay completed phases.
truth_rules.overinstrumentation_guard: OPS3 uses milestone receipts, not activity receipts. Status reads, polling, per-platform CI results, artifact inspection, owner re-entry, sibling/lane scans, queue-empty checks, fresh-main observations, rebase checks, mergeability polling and merge mechanics are not material progress and must not create lane-state receipts.
truth_rules.lane_state_milestones: Ordinary persistent-lane execution state is selected_not_started -> in_progress -> prequeue_green -> published, followed by one deterministic successor reseed after canonical closeout. The generic lane activity-log API is prohibited.
truth_rules.closeout_fast_path: After application publication, canonical closeout is one bounded phase: atomic closeout candidate validation -> READY CAS -> fresh-main integration check -> exact merge -> durable queue reconcile -> one successor reseed. No intermediate lane-state writes.
truth_rules.domain_authority_rule: When CURRENT.json names a domain authority relevant to the requested scope, that referenced authority defines current domain canon. Historical or generated domain material cannot override it; domain authority cannot select work or expand lane scope.
truth_rules.single_active_lane_mode: When exactly one persistent implementation lane is nonterminal, derive that mode once and execute only that lane plus concrete dependencies. Do not rescan terminal siblings, check concurrent writers, consult an empty READY queue, or perform routine rebase/update-branch work.
truth_rules.publication_mode_rule: Derive publication mode once from fresh CURRENT: zero nonterminal lanes means no publication, one means single_lane_direct, two or more means ready_queue. Do not keep rescanning unless a concrete invalidating event occurs.
truth_rules.owner_reentry_diagnostic: Repeated owner execution commands remain diagnostic input for stall detection but must not create a lane-state write solely to count the interaction. Aggregate interaction-quality evidence only into an already-required terminal/closeout record.
truth_rules.no_routine_rebase: OPS3 never requires routine rebasing. In single-active-lane mode base drift reruns only the narrow fresh-base integration gate; a candidate-head change occurs only for a real conflict or repair and then receives exact-head revalidation.
truth_rules.runner_pool_capacity: Platform validation labels describe pools, not named machines. Multiple isolated self-hosted runner services may share the same required labels. Lightweight selector/health and deterministic comparison should avoid the scarce validation pool when workstation-local capabilities are unnecessary.
truth_rules.stale_validation_containment: Validation concurrency is scoped to the immutable candidate head. Duplicate runs of the same head cancel, but an obsolete head cannot block a newer head from entering validation. Exact-head evidence prevents stale results from being consumed; cross-platform comparison starts only after every required platform validation succeeds.
truth_rules.runner_observation_not_progress: Runner queue state, cancellation, process lifetime and capacity observations are infrastructure evidence only and cannot create lane-state progress receipts.
